decisions.decision: Unpark and build T-238 now, using only the vendor-sim and test mode. (1) In cloud/src/connectors/build.ts stripeEnsureCheckout, add payment_intent_data[metadata][funnel] and [product] to the payment link. Also add charge.refunded to the enabled_events of the webhook it creates or updates. (2) In cloud/funnel/worker.js /hooks/stripe (line 870), once the signature is verified, handle charge.refunded. Read the funnel and product from the charge metadata, or fetch the payment_intent's metadata if the charge doesn't carry it. Call refunded(env, billing_details.email || receipt_email, {id, payment: payment_intent}) only when refunded===true and amount_refunded===amount and the funnel and product match. This mirrors the Dodo path at line 866. (3) Add vendor-sim support for charge.refunded, plus a probe with three cases: a full refund gets the refunded tag and shows in the dashboard refunds count, a partial refund changes nothing, and another product's refund changes nothing. Commit, push and deploy the funnel Worker, then set the task to review for Adi and Aquila.
decisions.why: On 2026-10-06 Adi said 'focus on Dodo right now'. That was about order of work, and the Dodo refund path (worker.js:866) and T-122 are now done. His 2026-10-09 rule is to finish everything end to end. Stripe is an approved attendee payment option (owner-decisions-2026-10-06), so the fix is small and contained.
